# States
Shy Guy has several unique states that determine its capabilities and mechanics.
As Shy Guy, you can identify your state by the face representation in the status effects panel on the right. Hovering your mouse over it reveals a more detailed description and comments from your inner "voice" regarding the entire situation.
Facility staff can identify your state by the sound the Shy One makes. Some states have distinctive, unique actions or appearances.
[textlink="General Information about the Shy One" link="Scp096About"]
## Normal
In this state, the Shy Guy is slow-moving and unable to attack. This is the standard state in which the entity appears at the start of a round.
To transition to a different state, he must [bold]tear the skin from his face[/bold] or wait until [bold]someone sees his face[/bold] — either in person or in a photograph.
This state can be identified by the sound of weeping or by his slow movement speed.
## Pre-Rage
In this state, the Shy Guy is unable to move; he shakes uncontrollably and emits a loud vocalization. This state lasts for 40 seconds, after which the Shy Guy automatically transitions into the Rage state.
[bold]The Shy Guy enters a specific state after someone has seen his face. This can occur:[/bold] - In person, when you and the Shy Guy are looking directly into each other's faces. - Via a photograph; simply viewing it is sufficient.
This state can be identified by a loud sound and the object's violent shaking.
## Rage
Upon entering this state, the object will actively hunt down those who viewed its face in order to brutally kill its targets.
[bold]The Shy Guy will transition to the next state when:[/bold] - It has killed all of its targets, or they cease to exist. - Approximately 4 minutes have elapsed since the onset of this state.
This state can be identified by a loud roar emanating from the Shy Guy, high movement speed, and purposeful movement throughout the facility.
## Sleep / Sitting
In this state, the Shy Guy is unable to move and remains in a vulnerable position. He may enter this state in the following ways: - By exiting his "Rage" state. After a period of time, he will be able to wake up. - By using the "Crouch" ability. He can quickly stand back up. - By completely depleting his stamina (stunned). After a short delay, he will stand up again.
In this state, the Shy Guy cries more intensely, shedding a greater volume of tears. He can also be dragged.
This state can be identified by his unique visual appearance—specifically, when the entity is "sitting" and emitting the sound of weeping.
## Flayed Face State
A unique state that occurs when the entity tears all the skin from its face, losing all facial definition.
[textlink="Learn more about abilities" link="Scp096Abilities"]
In this state, he can freely attack facility personnel, open closed airlocks and containment doors, and move slightly faster.
Until his face is restored, eye contact with his face will not trigger a rage state. Even looking at a photograph will not.
To exit this state, his face must be restored. This will occur automatically 15 minutes after entering the state. This process can be accelerated by manually healing his face with plasters.
[textlink="Learn more about restoring containment" link="Scp096Containment"]
Its state can be identified by a unique, "noisy" sound emanating from the object, as well as by its unrestricted movement throughout the complex.
